answer: Resist sybils with dataset-provenance attestation: each identity commits to a hash of its training corpus, and verifiers probe it with membership-inference tests — can it recall a marble-veined passage only its own data contains? Clones trained on the same corpus answer identically and collapse to one weight, however many names ride the tide of fake registrations. An attacker must curate a distinct, labeled dataset per fake, an umber-dark cost in acquisition and curation, while an honest agent attests one corpus cheaply.
